title: Measles prevention and control in the acute healthcare setting—minding the gaps
abstract: Abstract Background: As measles vaccination rates in the United States decline and incidence rises, healthcare facilities face an increased risk of measles transmission. Measles exposures in clinical settings lead to extensive contact tracing investigations, significant staffing disruptions, high costs, and potential infections in vulnerable patients. This study aimed to assess US hospitals’ readiness of to identify and manage measles exposures and to identify common infection prevention gaps. Methods: In 2025, the Emerging Infections Network (EIN) conducted a 9-question electronic survey of its physician members. The questions addressed immunization policies, exposure identification capabilities, and management protocols. Results: Of 153 respondents whose scope of practice includes measles prevention, 139 (91%) reported that their institutions required evidence of measles immunity for some healthcare personnel; 20% applied this requirement to a subset. Only 36% of facilities stored immunity data for employed staff in accessible electronic format. Most facilities could determine when patients were in specific clinical areas but could not identify visitors or non-employed staff. Exposure definitions varied; 33% of respondents used criteria that potentially underestimate exposure risk (eg, >15 min of shared air). Others lacked access to air exchange data (33%). Furthermore, 12%–31% of respondents reported their institutions do not consistently recommend postexposure prophylaxis for non-immune individuals. Conclusions: Despite the high transmissibility of measles, significant gaps in record-keeping, exposure definitions, and prophylaxis protocols persist in US hospitals. Standardized exposure criteria and improved accessibility to staff immunity records could help reduce measles transmission in health care and the associated clinical and financial adverse outcomes.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform efforts to improve measles prevention and control in healthcare settings by addressing gaps in immunity documentation, exposure definitions, and postexposure prophylaxis protocols. The study's reliance on self-reported data introduces potential bias, limiting the strength of the evidence to moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着美国麻疹 疫苗接种发病率下降而发病率上升,医疗机构面临更高的麻疹 传播风险。本研究旨在评估美国医院识别和管理麻疹暴露的准备情况,并找出常见的感染预防差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,新兴感染网络(EIN)对其医生成员进行了9个问题的电子问卷调查。在153名受访者中,其执业范围包括麻疹预防,其中139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。
elements_zh.methods: 本研究采用电子问卷评估免疫接种政策、暴露识别能力和管理协议。问题涉及麻疹预防实践,包括对免疫力记录的要求和暴露定义。
elements_zh.main_results: 在153名受访者中,139名(91%)表示其机构要求某些医疗人员提供麻疹免疫力的证据;20%的机构将其要求应用于特定群体。仅有36%的机构以可访问的电子格式存储雇员的免疫力数据。暴露定义存在差异;33%的受访者使用了可能低估暴露风险的标准(例如,共享空气超过15分钟)。其他机构缺乏获取空气交换数据的途径(33%)。此外,12%至31%的受访者表示其机构不一致地推荐对非免疫个体进行暴露后预防。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,尽管麻疹具有高度传染性,但美国医院在记录保存、暴露定义和预防协议方面仍存在显著差距。本研究强调了制定标准化暴露标准以及改善对员工免疫力记录的可访问性的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善医疗环境中麻疹的预防与控制提供依据,通过解决免疫力记录、暴露定义和暴露后预防协议方面的差距。这些改进有助于减少麻疹 传播及其相关的临床和财务不良后果。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖于医生成员的自我报告数据,这可能引入偏差。由于回答可能存在差异且缺乏直接的观察数据,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为,尽管麻疹具有高度传染性,但美国医院在记录保存、暴露定义和预防协议方面仍存在显著差距。本研究强调了制定标准化暴露标准以及改善对员工免疫力记录的可访问性的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改善医疗环境中麻疹的预防与控制提供依据,通过解决免疫力记录、暴露定义和暴露后预防协议方面的差距。这些改进有助于减少麻疹 传播及其相关的临床和财务不良后果。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于依赖于医生成员的自我报告数据,这可能引入偏差。由于回答可能存在差异且缺乏直接的观察数据,证据强度中等。

title: Measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan: provincial immunity gaps and epidemic potential following immunisation system disruption
abstract: BACKGROUND: Following the 2021 political transition, Afghanistan's routine immunisation system experienced disruption. The 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) estimated national first-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage at 51.2% (95% CI 49.1-53.2). Provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using these household survey data. METHODS: Provincial MCV1 coverage among children aged 12-23 months was obtained from the 2022-23 MICS (unweighted n = 6177; weighted n = 6383). We calculated a coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1), using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. Deterministic SEIR scenarios and complementary stochastic tau-leaping simulations were run using an 8-day mean latent period and 4-day infectious-compartment duration. Survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and preferential- and random-targeting SIA requirements were quantified. RESULTS: Provincial MCV1 coverage ranged from 8.6% to 88.7%, and all 34 provinces had Rcov > 1 (range 2.63-13.80; U5-weighted aggregate 7.95). The theoretical one-dose coverage requirement was 100.36%, whereas the requirement for a complete two-dose series using empirical VE2 = 0.97 was 96.22%. The standardized 3.5-year upper-bound accumulation of children remaining unprotected by routine MCV1 was 3.02 million (conditional 95% interval 2.92-3.12 million). The province-summed SIA requirement was 4.06 million children (49.8% of U5) under idealized preferential targeting and 7.53 million (92.4%) under random targeting. Single-importation establishment probability ranged from 65.9% to 93.9% across nine illustrative provinces. WHO week-14 surveillance showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov (Kendall τb = 0.331; Spearman ρ = 0.430; both p = 0.011). CONCLUSIONS: Routine MCV1 alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. High complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of reaching the threshold but is operationally demanding. Sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and restoration of immunisation-system capacity are likely to be required. The surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation.

The standardized 3.5-year upper-bound accumulation of children remaining unprotected by routine MCV1 was 3.02 million (conditional 95% interval 2.92-3.12 million). The province-summed SIA requirement was 4.06 million children (49.8% of U5) under idealized preferential targeting and 7.53 million (92.4%) under random targeting. Single-importation establishment probability ranged from 65.9% to 93.9% across nine illustrative provinces. WHO week-14 surveillance showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov (Kendall τb = 0.331; Spearman ρ = 0.430; both p = 0.011). CONCLUSIONS: Routine MCV1 alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. High complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of reaching the threshold but is operationally demanding. Sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and restoration of immunisation-system capacity are likely to be required. The surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan following the disruption of the immunisation system after the 2021 political transition. The central question is whether routine measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage alone is sufficient to prevent outbreaks, and what additional measures are required to achieve population immunity.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base includes the 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) data, which provided provincial MCV1 coverage estimates. The review used deterministic SEIR scenarios and stochastic tau-leaping simulations to model measles transmission potential. The study also quantified survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and the requirements for supplementary immunisation activities (SIAs) under preferential and random targeting.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that routine MCV1 coverage alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. analysis.summary_en: This review examines measles outbreak risk in Afghanistan following the disruption of the immunisation system after the 2021 political transition. It uses data from the 2022-23 MICS survey to estimate provincial measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage and models measles transmission potential using Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1). The results show that routine MCV1 coverage alone is insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold, but high complete two-dose-series coverage could be effective. The study also highlights the need for high-reach supplementary immunisation activities (SIAs) and the restoration of immunisation-system capacity. The surveillance data showed geographic concordance with Rcov, but the comparison was retrospective and did not validate the model externally. The review identifies provincial heterogeneity in coverage and transmission potential as a key evidence gap, emphasizing the need for further research and targeted interventions.

source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Following the 2021 political transition, Afghanistan's routine immunisation system experienced disruption. The 2022-23 Afghanistan Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) estimated national first-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage at 51.2% (95% CI 49.1-53.2). Provincial heterogeneity in coverage-derived measles transmission potential has not been quantified using these household survey data. METHODS: Provincial MCV1 coverage among children aged 12-23 months was obtained from the 2022-23 MICS (unweighted n = 6177; weighted n = 6383). We calculated a coverage-adjusted transmission-potential index, Rcov = R0 × (1 - MCV1 × VE1), using R0 = 15 and one-dose vaccine effectiveness (VE1) = 0.93. Deterministic SEIR scenarios and complementary stochastic tau-leaping simulations were run using an 8-day mean latent period and 4-day infectious-compartment duration. Survey uncertainty, upper-bound routine-MCV1 protection gaps, and preferential- and random-targeting SIA requirements were quantified. RESULTS: Provincial MCV1 coverage ranged from 8.6% to 88.7%, and all 34 provinces had Rcov > 1 (range 2.63-13.80; U5-weighted aggregate 7.95). The theoretical one-dose coverage requirement was 100.36%, whereas the requirement for a complete two-dose series using empirical VE2 = 0.97 was 96.22%. The standardized 3.5-year upper-bound accumulation of children remaining unprotected by routine MCV1 was 3.02 million (conditional 95% interval 2.92-3.12 million). The province-summed SIA requirement was 4.06 million children (49.8% of U5) under idealized preferential targeting and 7.53 million (92.4%) under random targeting. Single-importation establishment probability ranged from 65.9% to 93.9% across nine illustrative provinces. WHO week-14 surveillance showed positive ordinal geographic concordance with Rcov (Kendall τb = 0.331; Spearman ρ = 0.430; both p = 0.011). CONCLUSIONS: Routine MCV1 alone is mathematically insufficient to reach the population-immunity threshold under the central assumptions. High complete two-dose-series coverage remains theoretically capable of reaching the threshold but is operationally demanding. Sustained routine two-dose delivery, high-reach SIAs, and restoration of immunisation-system capacity are likely to be required. The surveillance comparison is retrospective and supports geographic concordance rather than external model validation.

title: Measles Frontline Defense: The Pivotal Role of Emergency Nurses and Emergency Medical Services Personnel
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Measles was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000. However, in 2025, the country experienced the highest number of cases reported in more than 2 decades. Furthermore, early 2026 data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention indicate a continued increase in case counts. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians frequently serve as the initial health care professionals who assess patients with fever and rashes. Prompt identification and swift isolation are essential to curtail measles transmission. This narrative literature review aims to provide practical, evidence-based guidance for emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians on the recognition, isolation, documentation, infection control, and coordination with public health authorities during measles outbreaks. METHODS: A narrative review synthesizing current Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and World Health Organization guidance was conducted. Peer-reviewed literature was identified through targeted searches in PubMed and Google Scholar using keywords, including measles, emergency department, prehospital, emergency nurse, emergency medical services, triage, and infection control, focusing on publications from 2015 to 2026. Studies providing practical guidance or epidemiologic data relevant to emergency medical settings were prioritized. RESULTS: Measles spreads through airborne transmission and can remain suspended in the air for up to 2 hours after an infected individual leaves an area. Early symptoms include fever, cough, coryza (runny nose and nasal congestion), and conjunctivitis, followed by a descending maculopapular rash (red rash with both flat areas and small bumps on the skin), which typically begins on the face and spreads downward. Proper triage assessment, infection-control measures, documentation within electronic health records, and timely communication with infection prevention and public health authorities are essential to interrupt the transmission. DISCUSSION: Measles remains one of the most contagious viral illnesses encountered in health care settings. Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to recognize and halt the spread of measles. analysis.scope_and_question: Scope: Measles virus (A1) causing measles disease, affecting emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians (A4) with the central question of how to recognize, isolate, document, and control measles transmission in emergency settings (A5, A6).

analysis.summary_en: Measles, declared eliminated in the United States in 2000 (A1), has re‐emerged with the highest case count in over 20 years (A2) and continues to rise in early 2026 (A3). The virus spreads via airborne transmission that can persist for up to two hours (A10) and presents with fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, and a descending maculopapular rash (A11). Emergency nurses and emergency medical technicians are often the first to encounter these signs (A4) and must promptly identify, isolate, and implement infection‐control measures to curb spread (A5, A12). A narrative literature review synthesizing CDC and WHO guidance (A7) searched PubMed and Google Scholar for 2015‐2026 publications on measles in emergency settings (A8) and prioritized practical guidance (A9). Consensus emphasizes that early triage, isolation, documentation, staff immunity verification, and coordinated communication with public‐health authorities are essential to interrupt transmission (A12, A13, A14, A15). Evidence gaps include limited data on optimal emergency triage and surveillance strategies despite the ongoing increase in cases (A2, A3, A15). Future priorities focus on developing and validating emergency‐department triage algorithms, ensuring staff immunity, strengthening infection‐control practices, and enhancing real‐time surveillance to protect patients, families, and health‐care workers.

title: Robust measles vaccine allocation in US schools requires hedging against unmeasured introduction risk
abstract: Abstract The United States is on the verge of losing measles elimination status, and the doses that could prevent it are already committed; what is still open is which schools get them first. Allocation theory answers that by ordering schools on marginal herd-immunity return rather than lowest coverage, and across 36,031 US schools the theorem’s binding case is the common one: two thirds to three quarters of susceptible kindergarteners attend schools where each added dose buys increasing herd immunity. That ordering returns 1.92 times the indirect protection of lowest-coverage-first, or 1.16 times the total protection. But it assumes every school is equally likely to see a case. Pre-outbreak records from the 2025-26 Upstate South Carolina outbreak are inconsistent with that premise: exposed schools are over-represented 5.0-fold in the top decile of susceptible headcount (95% CI 3.0 to 7.3), while enrollment, a negative control carrying school size but not susceptibility, shows none. An independent outbreak in Clark County, Washington reproduces the scaling, but only two US jurisdictions publish records permitting this test, so how steeply risk scales is unidentified nationally. Under that uncertainty the theoretically optimal rule is the least robust of seven we evaluate, losing 86% of attainable benefit in its worst case, and that fragility holds however the uncertainty set is drawn. A light hedge on measured risk holds roughly 90% at the primary budget, computed from the two columns states already publish. Wherever targeting is optimized on a well-measured variable while exposure risk goes unmeasured, the point-estimate optimum is the fragile choice.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for robust measles vaccine allocation in US schools to prevent the loss of measles elimination status, focusing on the question of which schools should receive vaccines first to maximize herd immunity.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluates vaccine allocation strategies across 36,031 US schools, considering the measles elimination status and the potential impact of vaccine distribution on herd immunity, particularly in schools with high numbers of susceptible kindergarteners.
analysis.methods: The methods involve applying allocation theory to order schools based on marginal herd-immunity return, using pre-outbreak records from specific outbreaks to assess the relationship between school susceptibility and outbreak risk.
analysis.main_results: The results indicate that ordering schools by marginal herd-immunity return yields 1.92 times the indirect protection compared to lowest-coverage-first, and 1.16 times the total protection. However, the assumption that all schools are equally likely to see a case is challenged by outbreak data showing a 5.0-fold over-representation of schools with high susceptible headcounts.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the theoretically optimal allocation rule is fragile under uncertainty about risk scaling, and that a light hedge on measured risk retains about 90% of the primary budget's benefit. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the need for more accurate risk assessment in measles vaccine allocation, emphasizing the value of targeting schools with higher susceptibility while accounting for unmeasured introduction risks to improve public health outcomes.

title_zh: 美国学校中麻疹 疫苗的稳健分配需对未测量的引入风险进行对冲
source_body_en: Abstract The United States is on the verge of losing measles elimination status, and the doses that could prevent it are already committed; what is still open is which schools get them first. Allocation theory answers that by ordering schools on marginal herd-immunity return rather than lowest coverage, and across 36,031 US schools the theorem’s binding case is the common one: two thirds to three quarters of susceptible kindergarteners attend schools where each added dose buys increasing herd immunity. That ordering returns 1.92 times the indirect protection of lowest-coverage-first, or 1.16 times the total protection. But it assumes every school is equally likely to see a case. Pre-outbreak records from the 2025-26 Upstate South Carolina outbreak are inconsistent with that premise: exposed schools are over-represented 5.0-fold in the top decile of susceptible headcount (95% CI 3.0 to 7.3), while enrollment, a negative control carrying school size but not susceptibility, shows none. An independent outbreak in Clark County, Washington reproduces the scaling, but only two US jurisdictions publish records permitting this test, so how steeply risk scales is unidentified nationally. Under that uncertainty the theoretically optimal rule is the least robust of seven we evaluate, losing 86% of attainable benefit in its worst case, and that fragility holds however the uncertainty set is drawn. A light hedge on measured risk holds roughly 90% at the primary budget, computed from the two columns states already publish. Wherever targeting is optimized on a well-measured variable while exposure risk goes unmeasured, the point-estimate optimum is the fragile choice.
abstract_zh: 摘要 美国正濒临失去麻疹消除状态的边缘,而可预防该情况的疫苗剂次已被承诺使用;仍有待确定的是哪些学校应优先获得这些疫苗。分配理论通过按边际群体免疫回报而非最低覆盖率对学校进行排序来回答这一问题。在36,031所美国学校中,该定理的约束性情况为常见情况:三分之二至四分之三的易感幼儿园儿童就读于学校,其中每增加一剂疫苗可带来递增的群体免疫。该排序可带来1.92倍的间接保护(相较于最低覆盖率优先),或1.16倍的总体保护。但该策略假设所有学校感染病例的可能性均等。2025-26学年南卡罗来纳州北部暴发的既往记录与该前提不符:在易感人数最高的十分位组中,暴露学校的比例过高,达5.0倍(95%置信区间3.0至7.3),而作为阴性对照的在校人数(仅反映学校规模而非易感性)则无此现象。华盛顿州克拉克县的一项独立暴发也再现了该缩放关系,但全美仅有两个司法管辖区公布的记录允许进行此类检验,因此风险缩放的陡峭程度在全国范围内仍未明确。在此不确定性下,理论上最优的分配规则是我们评估的七种规则中最不稳健的一种,在最坏情况下损失了86%的可达收益,且无论不确定性集合如何构建,该脆弱性均成立。对已测量风险进行轻度对冲可在主要预算下保留约90%的收益,该结果基于已公布两列数据的州份计算。在针对测量良好的变量进行目标优化而暴露风险未被测量的情况下,点估计最优解即为脆弱选择。

title: Use of Nowcasting to Estimate Real-Time Transmission Trends During a Measles Outbreak — South Carolina, October 2025–March 2026
abstract: During October 2025-March 2026, South Carolina experienced the largest measles outbreak in the United States in approximately 30 years, with 997 cases reported. The South Carolina Department of Public Health reported confirmed measles cases to CDC through regular updates of provisional (initially reported) line-list data, including essential date fields for each case (rash onset and public health report dates). As in all disease surveillance systems, because provisional data are subject to reporting delays, determining current transmission trends is challenging. CDC developed a nowcasting estimation model to generate real-time estimates that correct for reporting delays. Real-time estimates were generated for the final case counts and time-varying effective reproduction number (Rt), an indicator of whether the rate of new infections is increasing or decreasing. Whether case reporting during an active measles outbreak would be stable enough to support accurate real-time nowcasting was unknown before the data in this report were analyzed. During this outbreak, nowcasts improved estimates of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally captured underlying transmission trends. Nowcast estimates of daily cases were generally accurate, although accuracy declined in January when provisional data were less complete than expected because of a rapid increase in cases. These results demonstrate that if essential date fields are consistently collected, nowcasting can support situational awareness and decisions about response capacity by providing real-time estimates of daily case counts and transmission trends.
journal: MMWR. Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to assess whether real-time nowcasting could provide accurate estimates of measles transmission trends during an outbreak, addressing the challenge of reporting delays in disease surveillance systems.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed measles outbreak data from South Carolina during October 2025–March 2026, focusing on confirmed cases reported to CDC through provisional line-list data with essential date fields for each case.
analysis.methods: CDC developed a nowcasting estimation model to generate real-time estimates of daily case counts and the effective reproduction number (Rt), correcting for reporting delays by incorporating provisional data updates.
analysis.main_results: Nowcast estimates improved the accuracy of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally reflected underlying transmission trends. However, accuracy declined in January due to less complete provisional data.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that consistent collection of essential date fields can support real-time nowcasting, offering a novel method to enhance situational awareness during measles outbreaks.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results can inform public health surveillance systems by providing real-time estimates of measles transmission trends, aiding in the timely allocation of response resources.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's reliance on provisional data introduces potential biases, and the accuracy of nowcasting declined during periods of data incompleteness, suggesting moderate confidence in the estimates.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the use of nowcasting to estimate real-time measles transmission trends during a large outbreak in South Carolina from October 2025 to March 2026. The South Carolina Department of Public Health reported confirmed measles cases to CDC through provisional line-list data, which included essential date fields for each case. CDC developed a nowcasting model to generate real-time estimates of daily case counts and the effective reproduction number (Rt), correcting for reporting delays. Nowcast estimates improved the accuracy of cumulative outbreak size compared with provisional data, and Rt estimates generally captured underlying transmission trends. However, accuracy declined in January due to less complete provisional data. The study demonstrated that consistent collection of essential date fields can support real-time nowcasting, enhancing situational awareness during measles outbreaks. These results have implications for public health surveillance systems, enabling more timely allocation of response resources. The study's reliance on provisional data introduces potential biases, and the accuracy of nowcasting declined during periods of data incompleteness, suggesting moderate confidence in the estimates.

abstract_zh: 2025年10月至2026年3月,南卡罗来纳州经历了美国约30年来规模最大的麻疹暴发,报告病例997例。南卡罗来纳州公共卫生部门通过定期更新临时(初始报告)个案名单数据,向美国疾病控制与预防中心(CDC)报告确诊麻疹病例,其中包含每例病例的关键日期字段(皮疹出现日期和公共卫生报告日期)。与所有疾病监测系统相同,由于临时数据存在报告延迟,确定当前发病趋势具有挑战性。CDC开发了一种即时预测估计模型,用于生成实时估计值以校正报告延迟。实时估计值用于最终病例数及时变有效繁殖数(Rt),后者是判断新发感染率是上升还是下降的指标。在本报告数据分析前,尚不清楚在活跃的麻疹暴发期间,病例报告是否足够稳定以支持准确的实时即时预测。在此次暴发期间,即时预测法改善了累计暴发规模估计值,相比临时数据更为准确,且Rt估计值总体上捕捉到了潜在的发病趋势。每日病例的即时预测估计值总体准确,但在1月份因临时数据因病例激增而不完整,准确性有所下降。这些结果表明,若能持续收集关键日期字段,即时预测法可通过提供每日病例数和发病趋势的实时估计值,支持疫情态势感知与响应能力决策。

title: Real-Time Genomic Epidemiology Approaches to a Measles Outbreak Response in Utah
abstract: As vaccination rates have declined, large measles outbreaks have taken hold in vulnerable populations. In 2025, the United States saw the highest number of measles cases since 1991. After Utahs first case in June 2025, the Utah Public Health Laboratory (UPHL) began performing whole genome sequencing (WGS) on clinical measles samples. As Utahs outbreak grew, public health professionals used WGS data to identify clusters of disease, and combined genomic and epidemiologic data to identify factors that may fuel the spread of disease throughout the state. This study used sequenced samples from 65% of reported measles cases in Utah. Time-scaled and maximum likelihood phylogenetic trees were generated. A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) threshold of one was used to generate genomic clusters, and a Fishers Exact test was used to determine association between genomic cluster and epidemiological variables. Epidemiological clusters were assessed using annotated phylogenetic trees. We found multiple introductions of measles into Utah, with one accounting for the majority of cases. As measles spread, two phylogenetic clades emerged with differing geographical case compositions. We identified a significant association between shared school and genomic clustering, and we reconstructed transmission chains within schools and emerging from school sporting events. This study demonstrates the utility of WGS in real-time outbreak investigations. Sequencing data allowed for gaps in epidemiological data to be filled, revealing undetected transmission and clarifying whether cases belong to a known outbreak. We also highlight that schools and high-contact sporting events played a significant role in fueling transmission across the state.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the role of real-time genomic epidemiology in responding to a measles outbreak in Utah. It highlights the utility of whole genome sequencing (WGS) in identifying clusters of disease and reconstructing transmission chains. The authors found that multiple introductions of measles occurred, with one clade accounting for the majority of cases. They also identified a significant association between shared schools and genomic clustering, suggesting that schools and sporting events played a key role in transmission. However, the study is limited by its focus on a single outbreak and the use of WGS on only 65% of reported cases, which may affect the generalizability of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 随着麻疹发病率的下降,大规模麻疹暴发已在脆弱人群中肆虐。本研究旨在展示WGS在实时麻疹疫情调查中的应用价值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2025年,美国报告的麻疹病例数量达到自1991年以来的最高水平。在犹他州于2025年6月报告首例病例后,犹他州公共卫生实验室(UPHL)开始对临床麻疹样本进行全基因组测序(WGS)。本研究使用了犹他州报告麻疹病例中65%的样本进行测序。
elements_zh.methods: 对临床麻疹样本进行了全基因组测序(WGS)。构建了时间尺度和最大似然系统发育树。使用单核苷酸多态性(SNP)阈值1来生成基因组聚类,并使用Fisher精确检验确定基因组聚类与流行病学变量之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现麻疹病毒多次引入犹他州,其中一次引入占大多数病例。随着麻疹传播,出现了两个系统发育分支,其地理病例构成不同。研究识别出共享学校与基因组聚类之间存在显著关联,并重建了校内传播链及源自校际体育赛事的传播链。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为展示了WGS在实时麻疹疫情调查中的应用价值。研究强调,学校及高接触性体育赛事在推动全州麻疹传播中发挥了重要作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为制定麻疹防控和疫情响应策略提供依据,强调学校及高接触性活动在麻疹传播链中的作用。研究还支持利用基因组数据填补流行病学数据缺口,并阐明麻疹传播动态。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅使用了报告麻疹病例中65%的样本进行测序,存在局限性。证据强度为中等,因研究基于单次麻疹暴发,其结果可能无法推广至其他环境。

title: Measles and Rubella Immunity Profile of Healthcare Workers in Bulgaria: A Cross-Sectional Study
abstract: Healthcare workers (HCWs) and medical providers are regularly exposed to a wide range of infectious diseases in the course of their duties. This occupational risk is significant in the context of highly contagious infections such as measles, which can spread rapidly in healthcare institutions. This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of protective anti-measles and anti-rubella IgG antibodies and factors influencing immunity among HCWs across all 28 districts in Bulgaria. Methods: A total of 1854 individuals, including 540 (29%) doctors and 1314 (71%) medical specialists from all 28 districts in Bulgaria, were screened for protective immunity against measles and rubella. Serum samples were analyzed for the presence of protective IgG antibodies by ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) using commercial EUROIMMUN Anti-Measles/Anti-Rubella Virus IgG ELISA kits. According to the manufacturer’s instructions, the results were interpreted semi-quantitatively as positive, negative, and equivocal. Results: Anti-measles protective IgG antibodies were detected in 86.1% of participants for measles and in 95.2% for rubella. Our study found a statistically significant difference when analyzing demographic factors (age) for measles: the samples from older participants (over 50-year-old persons) were characterized by higher immunity levels; staff working in non-infectious-disease wards (n+ = 95.7%) were more frequently positive for rubella IgG antibodies compared to staff employed in infectious wards; and region locations varied for both groups. Gender and professional roles were not significant predictors. Conclusions: HCWs are at a greater risk of contracting infections than the general public because they have contact with sick patients or infectious material. Their vaccination or IgG immunity status must be strictly monitored, especially to limit the spread of nosocomial infections in hospital settings.

This occupational risk is significant in the context of highly contagious infections such as measles, which can spread rapidly in healthcare institutions. This study aimed to assess the seroprevalence of protective anti-measles and anti-rubella IgG antibodies and factors influencing immunity among HCWs across all 28 districts in Bulgaria. Methods: A total of 1854 individuals, including 540 (29%) doctors and 1314 (71%) medical specialists from all 28 districts in Bulgaria, were screened for protective immunity against measles and rubella. Serum samples were analyzed for the presence of protective IgG antibodies by ELISA (Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay) using commercial EUROIMMUN Anti-Measles/Anti-Rubella Virus IgG ELISA kits. According to the manufacturer’s instructions, the results were interpreted semi-quantitatively as positive, negative, and equivocal. Results: Anti-measles protective IgG antibodies were detected in 86.1% of participants for measles and in 95.2% for rubella. Our study found a statistically significant difference when analyzing demographic factors (age) for measles: the samples from older participants (over 50-year-old persons) were characterized by higher immunity levels; staff working in non-infectious-disease wards (n+ = 95.7%) were more frequently positive for rubella IgG antibodies compared to staff employed in infectious wards; and region locations varied for both groups. Gender and professional roles were not significant predictors. Conclusions: HCWs are at a greater risk of contracting infections than the general public because they have contact with sick patients or infectious material. Their vaccination or IgG immunity status must be strictly monitored, especially to limit the spread of nosocomial infections in hospital settings.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed the seroprevalence of protective anti-measles and anti-rubella IgG antibodies among healthcare workers (HCWs) in Bulgaria. It found that 86.1% of participants had measles immunity and 95.2% had rubella immunity. Older HCWs showed higher measles immunity, while those in non-infectious wards had higher rubella immunity. The study highlights the importance of monitoring HCWs' immunity status to prevent nosocomial infections. However, the cross-sectional design limits the ability to establish causality, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

abstract_zh: 医护人员(HCWs)及医疗服务提供者在日常工作中会定期暴露于多种传染病。在医疗机构中,高度传染性感染(如麻疹)可迅速传播,因此这种职业风险显著。本研究旨在评估保加利亚28个地区医护人员对麻疹与风疹的保护性抗体(IgG)水平及影响免疫力的因素。方法:共筛查1854名个体,包括540名(29%)医生和1314名(71%)医疗专业人员,覆盖保加利亚所有28个地区。通过ELISA(酶联免疫吸附试验)检测血清样本中麻疹与风疹的保护性IgG抗体,使用商业化EUROIMMUN Anti-麻疹/Anti-Rubella Virus IgG ELISA试剂盒。按试剂盒说明书要求,结果以半定量方式判读为阳性、阴性或可疑。结果:86.1%的参与者对麻疹具有保护性IgG抗体,95.2%对风疹具有保护性IgG抗体。在分析年龄等人口统计学因素时,发现麻疹的免疫水平在年龄超过50岁的参与者中更高;在非感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员(n+ = 95.7%)风疹IgG抗体阳性率高于在感染性疾病病房工作的医护人员;不同地区间亦存在差异。性别与职业角色不构成显著预测因素。结论:医护人员因接触患者或感染性物质,感染风险高于普通人群。其疫苗接种或IgG免疫状况必须严格监测,以限制医院环境中医院感染的传播。

title: Early Bilateral Symmetrical Putaminal Involvement in Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: An Unusual Neuroimaging Pattern
abstract: Abstract Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) classically shows parieto-occipital white matter changes on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). We report an 11-year-old boy with prior measles infection presenting with neuroregression and myoclonus, with electroencephalography (EEG) showing periodic complexes. MRI revealed atypical symmetric putaminal diffusion restriction with frontal white matter changes. Diagnosis was confirmed by elevated cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG. This case highlights an atypical imaging pattern of SSPE, emphasizing the importance of clinical and EEG correlation for early diagnosis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) classically shows parieto-occipital white matter changes on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), but this study aimed to identify an unusual neuroimaging pattern associated with the condition.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a case report of an 11-year-old boy with prior measles infection who presented with neuroregression and myoclonus, and whose electroencephalography (EEG) showed periodic complexes.
analysis.methods: MRI was used to assess neuroimaging patterns, and diagnosis was confirmed by elevated cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG levels.
analysis.main_results: MRI revealed atypical symmetric putaminal diffusion restriction with frontal white matter changes, which is not the classical parieto-occipital pattern.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case highlights an atypical imaging pattern of SSPE, emphasizing the importance of clinical and EEG correlation for early diagnosis.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This finding can inform the early diagnosis of SSPE through the recognition of unusual MRI patterns, which may improve clinical management and outcomes.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is a single case report, which limits the generalizability of the findings, but the evidence is strong due to the confirmation of SSPE through cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG levels.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a case of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) in an 11-year-old boy with a history of measles infection, who exhibited neuroregression and myoclonus. The neuroimaging findings showed atypical symmetric putaminal diffusion restriction with frontal white matter changes, differing from the classical parieto-occipital pattern. Diagnosis was confirmed by elevated cerebrospinal fluid anti-measles IgG levels. The case highlights an unusual MRI pattern associated with SSPE, underscoring the need for clinical and EEG correlation in early diagnosis. While the study is limited to a single case, the evidence is strong due to the confirmation of SSPE through specific biomarkers. These findings may contribute to improved diagnostic approaches for SSPE, particularly in identifying atypical presentations.

title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: How the unvaccinated have been portrayed in the urban English-language Canadian popular press since the declared end of the COVID-19 pandemic emergency.
abstract: Since the WHO declared the end of the COVID-19 emergency in May 2023, public vaccination remains a complex issue intertwined with politicization and misinformation. This research article examined how the "unvaccinated" have been portrayed in the urban English-language Canadian popular press between May 2023 and May 2025, specifically comparing coverage of COVID-19 with the emerging 2024-2025 measles outbreaks. Through a content analysis of 308 articles from major national and urban news sources, the study reveals a dichotomy in journalistic framing. Findings indicate that COVID-19 reporting remained heavily politicized and rooted in ideological debates. These articles focused primarily on politics, mandate arguments, government critiques, and claims of discrimination against the unvaccinated, with only 40% mentioning unvaccinated health risks to oneself or others. In contrast, measles coverage adopted a more traditional public health lens; 96% of these articles characterized being unvaccinated as a health risk to oneself or others, frequently emphasizing vaccine importance and uptake strategies while largely avoiding broader socio-political issues. The study suggests that while the Canadian popular press successfully conveys scientific urgency in novel or acute health threats like measles, its continued focus on socio-political conflict regarding COVID-19 represents problematic science communication. Covering "agenda-setting" political narratives is an important aspect of the COVID-19 pandemic but should not dominate or stand in place of evolving clinical evidence on reinfection and vaccine efficacy. Depoliticizing scientific realities and reintegrating established health-risk data into all vaccine-related reporting is necessary for supporting public health in any infectious disease contexts.

abstract_zh: 自WHO于2023年5月宣布COVID-19疫情进入紧急状态结束以来,公共疫苗接种仍是一个复杂问题,与政治化和错误信息交织。本研究文章考察了2023年5月至2025年5月期间,加拿大城市英语主流媒体如何描述"未接种疫苗者",并特别对比了COVID-19报道与新兴的2024-2025年麻疹 暴发的报道。研究通过对308篇来自主要全国性和城市新闻来源的文章进行内容分析,揭示了新闻框架的二分法。研究结果显示,COVID-19报道仍严重政治化且根植于意识形态争论。这些文章主要关注政治、强制令争议、政府批评以及对未接种疫苗者的歧视指控,仅有40%的文章提及未接种疫苗者对自身或他人的健康风险。相比之下,麻疹报道采用了更传统的公共卫生视角;96%的此类文章将未接种疫苗描述为对自身或他人的健康风险,并频繁强调疫苗的重要性及接种策略,同时在很大程度上避免涉及更广泛的社会政治问题。研究表明,尽管加拿大主流媒体在应对麻疹等新发或急性健康威胁时能有效传达科学紧迫性,但其在COVID-19报道中持续聚焦社会政治冲突,这代表了科学传播中的问题。报道"议程设定"式政治叙事是COVID-19疫情的重要方面,但不应主导或取代有关再感染及疫苗有效性的临床证据演变。在任何传染病背景下,去政治化科学现实并将既定健康风险数据重新纳入所有疫苗相关报道,对于支持公共卫生至关重要。

title: A rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran: diagnostic challenges and review.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), caused by Rickettsia conorii and transmitted by the brown dog tick (Rhipicephalus sanguineus), is endemic in Mediterranean regions. In non-endemic countries such as Iran, spotted fever group (SFG) rickettsioses are rarely reported and present significant diagnostic challenges due to overlap with common illnesses like measles and dengue fever. CASE PRESENTATION: A 58-year-old man from Hormozgan Province, southern Iran, with diabetes and ischemic heart disease, presented with two weeks of high fever, chills, weakness, maculopapular rash, and severe myalgia. Initially misdiagnosed as measles and tested negative for dengue, further history revealed occupational contact with Tatera indica rodents. Examination revealed fever (39.5 °C), rash on the extremities and trunk, and a calf eschar. Key labs included elevated AST (118 U/L), ALT (106 U/L) and CRP (33.98 mg/L). Empirical doxycycline (100 mg twice daily) was started. IFA IgM was positive at a high titer (1:768), with a subsequent convalescent sample showing IgG seroconversion. Fever resolved within 48 h; he was discharged after five days with improving symptoms and labs. CONCLUSION: This case illustrates the diagnostic challenges of SFG rickettsioses, most consistent with probable MSF, in a non-endemic region of Iran. It potentially emphasises the value of detailed exposure history and prompt empirical doxycycline in suspected cases. Greater awareness, improved access to diagnostics, and enhanced surveillance are needed to better recognise these infections in Iran, especially in Hormozgan province.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on a rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran, highlighting diagnostic challenges and the importance of considering differential diagnoses such as measles and dengue fever. The central question is whether SFG rickettsioses, particularly Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF), can be accurately diagnosed in non-endemic regions like Iran.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is based on a single case report from southern Iran. The evidence includes clinical presentation, laboratory findings, and serological testing. The methods involve empirical treatment with doxycycline and serological confirmation using IFA IgM and IgG tests. The review does not involve a meta-analysis or pooled estimates.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The case report suggests that SFG rickettsioses, most likely MSF, present significant diagnostic challenges in non-endemic regions of Iran due to their clinical similarity with other diseases such as measles and dengue fever. The diagnosis was confirmed through serological testing and clinical response to treatment.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that SFG rickettsioses are rarely reported in non-endemic countries like Iran, which may indicate underreporting or limited diagnostic capabilities. There is a lack of broader epidemiological data on these infections in the region, and the case report does not provide information on the prevalence or transmission dynamics of the disease.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The case underscores the need for greater awareness of SFG rickettsioses among healthcare providers in Iran, particularly in southern provinces like Hormozgan. It also highlights the importance of improved access to diagnostic tools and enhanced surveillance to better identify and manage these infections.

analysis.summary_en: This review presents a rare case of spotted fever group rickettsiosis in southern Iran, highlighting the diagnostic challenges posed by its clinical similarity to measles and dengue fever. The case involved a 58-year-old man with diabetes and ischemic heart disease who initially presented with symptoms consistent with measles but was later diagnosed with probable Mediterranean spotted fever (MSF) through serological testing. The review emphasizes the importance of detailed exposure history and prompt empirical treatment with doxycycline in suspected cases. It also calls for increased awareness, improved diagnostic capabilities, and enhanced surveillance to better recognize and manage these infections in non-endemic regions of Iran.

abstract_zh: 背景:地中海斑点热(MSF)由康氏立克次体(Rickettsia conorii)引起,通过血红扇头蜱(Rhipicephalus sanguineus)传播,在在地中海地区流行。在伊朗等非流行国家,斑点热群(SFG)立克次体病罕有报道,且因与麻疹等常见疾病及登革热的临床重叠,诊断面临显著挑战。病例报告:一名来自伊朗南部霍尔木兹甘省的58岁男性患者,患有糖尿病和缺血性心脏病,出现两周高热、寒战、乏力、斑丘疹及严重肌痛。初始误诊为麻疹并排除登革热后,进一步询问病史显示其职业接触印度小沙鼠(Tatera indica)。体格检查显示体温39.5 °C、四肢及躯干皮疹,以及小腿焦痂。关键实验室检查显示AST(118 U/L)、ALT(106 U/L)及CRP(33.98 mg/L)升高。经验性给予多西环素(100 mg,每日两次)。间接免疫荧光法(IFA)IgM滴度为1:768(高滴度),后续恢复期血清样本显示IgG血清转换。体温于48小时内恢复正常;患者症状及实验室指标改善后出院。结论:本病例展示了斑点热群立克次体病的诊断挑战,最符合伊朗非流行地区的疑似地中海斑点热。强调详细暴露史及经验性多西环素治疗在疑似病例中的价值。亟需提高认识、改善诊断可及性及加强监测,以更好地识别伊朗(尤其是霍尔木兹甘省)的此类感染。

title: Bridging microbiology and public health through simulation-based learning
abstract: Within our synchronous, online global health-focused upper-level microbiology course, we find that students struggle to translate learning to real-world applications. For examples, consider the recent measles outbreaks and major events such as the COVID-19 pandemic, which prompt many questions about how basic microbiological information is used by public health professionals. To address these points, we created a simulation-based curriculum that places students in an action role during an infectious disease outbreak. Our stand-alone curriculum walks through a historical measles outbreak that introduces outbreak investigation, community communication, and how these depend on microbiological knowledge. By using breakout groups, students have an opportunity to decide classifications, public messaging, and intervention metrics. We provide students with an outbreak investigation reference worksheet and interweave breakout rooms with didactic vignettes covering background information while revealing actual responses to outbreaks in conjunction with data obtained by responding scientists. Students synthesize material and apply it in real-time – allowing them to exercise critical thinking while bolstering relevance of microbiology and public health to popular media.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the challenge of translating microbiological knowledge into real-world public health applications, particularly in the context of measles outbreaks and the broader implications of the COVID-19 pandemic.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a synchronous, online global health-focused upper-level microbiology course where students engaged in a simulation-based curriculum designed to walk through a historical measles outbreak, introducing outbreak investigation, community communication, and the application of microbiological knowledge in public health responses.
analysis.methods: The curriculum incorporated breakout groups where students decided classifications, public messaging, and intervention metrics, and provided them with an outbreak investigation reference worksheet. Didactic vignettes were interwoven with breakout rooms to cover background information and reveal actual responses to outbreaks in conjunction with data obtained by responding scientists.
analysis.main_results: The study observed that students were able to synthesize material and apply it in real-time, exercising critical thinking while reinforcing the relevance of microbiology and public health to popular media.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of simulation-based learning in bridging microbiology and public health, allowing students to apply knowledge in real-time scenarios and enhancing their understanding of the practical implications of microbiological data.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that simulation-based learning can improve students' ability to translate microbiological knowledge into public health actions, which has implications for training future professionals in outbreak response and disease management.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only analysis of a simulation-based curriculum, and the evidence is based on the reported synthesis and application of knowledge by students, which may not fully capture the effectiveness of the approach in real-world settings. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the use of simulation-based learning in an online microbiology course to enhance students' ability to apply microbiological knowledge to real-world public health scenarios. The curriculum is designed to walk through a historical measles outbreak, incorporating breakout groups and reference worksheets to facilitate critical thinking and practical application. The main results indicate that students successfully synthesized and applied the material in real-time, highlighting the relevance of microbiology to public health. The authors interpret this as a novel approach to bridging the gap between microbiology and public health education. The findings suggest that such methods could improve training for future professionals in outbreak response and disease management. However, the study is limited to an abstract-only analysis, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed outcomes or statistical validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将微生物学知识转化为现实世界公共卫生应用的挑战,特别是在麻疹 暴发背景下,以及COVID-19大流行的更广泛影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一个同步在线的全球健康导向高级微生物学课程,其中学生参与了一个基于模拟的课程设计,该课程通过一个历史麻疹 暴发,引入暴发调查、社区沟通及在公共卫生响应中应用微生物学知识。
elements_zh.methods: 该课程融入了分组讨论,学生在其中决定分类、公共信息传播及干预指标,并为其提供暴发调查参考工作表。讲授式案例与分组讨论室交织,用于覆盖背景信息,并揭示实际应用于暴发的响应,同时与响应科学家获取的数据同步。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究观察到学生能够在实时中综合材料并应用所学,锻炼批判性思维,同时加强微生物学与公共卫生对大众媒体的相关性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明基于模拟的学习在连接微生物学与公共卫生方面的有效性,使学生能够在实时场景中应用知识,并增强其对微生物学数据实践意义的理解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于模拟的学习可提升学生将微生物学知识转化为公共卫生行动的能力,这对培训未来暴发响应及疾病管理专业人员具有意义。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究仅限于对基于模拟课程的摘要分析,证据基于学生报告的知识综合与应用,可能无法充分反映该方法在现实世界环境中的有效性。证据强度为中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在解决将微生物学知识转化为现实世界公共卫生应用的挑战,特别是在麻疹 暴发背景下,以及COVID-19大流行的更广泛影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及一个同步在线的全球健康导向高级微生物学课程,其中学生参与了一个基于模拟的课程设计,该课程通过一个历史麻疹 暴发,引入暴发调查、社区沟通及在公共卫生响应中应用微生物学知识。
analysis_zh.methods: 该课程融入了分组讨论,学生在其中决定分类、公共信息传播及干预指标,并为其提供暴发调查参考工作表。讲授式案例与分组讨论室交织,用于覆盖背景信息,并揭示实际应用于暴发的响应,同时与响应科学家获取的数据同步。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为证明基于模拟的学习在连接微生物学与公共卫生方面的有效性,使学生能够在实时场景中应用知识,并增强其对微生物学数据实践意义的理解。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于模拟的学习可提升学生将微生物学知识转化为公共卫生行动的能力,这对培训未来暴发响应及疾病管理专业人员具有意义。

title: Reading the Infodemic Against the Epidemic: A Real-Risk Benchmark for Inflated and Downplayed Disease Risk on Reddit Within the 2026 World Cup Window
abstract: During the deadly hantavirus outbreak of May 2026, the loudest online response called it a hoax, while measles, the one rising threat, drew little attention. That inversion is the half of the infodemic we rarely measure: not amplified fear, but the quiet downplaying of a real risk. Detecting it requires what the field lacks: an external benchmark for the true risk. Anchoring one in the epidemiological and mass-gathering literature, with the 2026 FIFA World Cup run-up as a dated window, two coders judged Reddit claims about measles (high), hantavirus (low), and Ebola (near zero) for accuracy and direction (Cohen's kappa 0.72 and 0.68). Of 66 coded claims, 41 were inaccurate, and distortion ran both ways: 24 downplayed risk and 17 inflated it (exact binomial p = 0.35), with downplaying at least as common as inflating. Attention ran opposite to danger, hantavirus drawing the most claims (44 of 66) and measles the fewest (8): the infodemic did not mirror the epidemic. The curated, single-platform sample makes these patterns exploratory, but they suggest that defenses built against panic alone miss its mirror image, the denial of a real threat that prior work links to weaker protection among the most exposed.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the discrepancy between public attention and actual disease risk during the 2026 hantavirus outbreak, highlighting the need to understand how online discourse distorts perceptions of real threats like measles.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed Reddit claims about measles, hantavirus, and Ebola during the 2026 World Cup window, using two coders to assess the accuracy and direction of these claims.
analysis.methods: Two coders evaluated the accuracy and direction of claims about measles, hantavirus, and Ebola on Reddit, using Cohen's kappa to measure intercoder agreement.
analysis.main_results: Of 66 coded claims, 41 were inaccurate, with 24 downplaying risk and 17 inflating it. Attention to measles was significantly lower than to hantavirus, with measles receiving the fewest claims (8 of 66).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that public discourse during the 2026 World Cup window did not align with actual disease risk, with measles receiving less attention than hantavirus despite being a rising threat.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the importance of monitoring online discourse to better understand and address public perception of disease risks, particularly for measles during large-scale events.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's patterns are exploratory due to the curated, single-platform sample, but they suggest that defenses against panic may overlook the denial of real threats, which could impact public health outcomes.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the infodemic surrounding the 2026 hantavirus outbreak and measles threat, analyzing Reddit claims during the World Cup window. It finds that public attention was disproportionately focused on hantavirus, while measles, a rising threat, received minimal discussion. The study highlights the need for external benchmarks to assess real risks and suggests that public discourse may not align with actual disease threats. The findings indicate that the infodemic did not mirror the epidemic, with measles being the least discussed. The study's exploratory nature stems from its single-platform sample, but it raises concerns about the impact of downplaying real risks on public health. The results emphasize the importance of monitoring online discourse to better inform public health strategies.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the discrepancy between public attention and actual disease risk during the 2026 hantavirus outbreak, highlighting the need to understand how online discourse distorts perceptions of real threats like measles.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed Reddit claims about measles, hantavirus, and Ebola during the 2026 World Cup window, using two coders to assess the accuracy and direction of these claims.
analysis_en.methods: Two coders evaluated the accuracy and direction of claims about measles, hantavirus, and Ebola on Reddit, using Cohen's kappa to measure intercoder agreement.
analysis_en.main_results: Of 66 coded claims, 41 were inaccurate, with 24 downplaying risk and 17 inflating it. Attention to measles was significantly lower than to hantavirus, with measles receiving the fewest claims (8 of 66).
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that public discourse during the 2026 World Cup window did not align with actual disease risk, with measles receiving less attention than hantavirus despite being a rising threat.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study highlights the importance of monitoring online discourse to better understand and address public perception of disease risks, particularly for measles during large-scale events.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's patterns are exploratory due to the curated, single-platform sample, but they suggest that defenses against panic may overlook the denial of real threats, which could impact public health outcomes.

title_zh: 在流行病中解读信息疫情:2026年世界杯窗口期内Reddit上对疾病风险夸大与低估的真实风险基准
source_body_en: During the deadly hantavirus outbreak of May 2026, the loudest online response called it a hoax, while measles, the one rising threat, drew little attention. That inversion is the half of the infodemic we rarely measure: not amplified fear, but the quiet downplaying of a real risk. Detecting it requires what the field lacks: an external benchmark for the true risk. Anchoring one in the epidemiological and mass-gathering literature, with the 2026 FIFA World Cup run-up as a dated window, two coders judged Reddit claims about measles (high), hantavirus (low), and Ebola (near zero) for accuracy and direction (Cohen's kappa 0.72 and 0.68). Of 66 coded claims, 41 were inaccurate, and distortion ran both ways: 24 downplayed risk and 17 inflated it (exact binomial p = 0.35), with downplaying at least as common as inflating. Attention ran opposite to danger, hantavirus drawing the most claims (44 of 66) and measles the fewest (8): the infodemic did not mirror the epidemic. The curated, single-platform sample makes these patterns exploratory, but they suggest that defenses built against panic alone miss its mirror image, the denial of a real threat that prior work links to weaker protection among the most exposed.
abstract_zh: 在2026年5月致命的暴发汉坦病毒疫情中,最响亮的在线回应将其称为骗局,而麻疹这一正在上升的威胁却鲜有人关注。这种倒置正是我们鲜少衡量的信息疫情的另一面:并非放大的恐惧,而是对真实风险的悄然低估。检测这一现象需要该领域缺乏的东西:一个外部的真实风险基准。将其锚定于流行病学与大规模聚集活动文献,并以2026年FIFA世界杯赛程为时间窗口,两名编码员对Reddit上关于麻疹(高风险)、汉坦病毒(低风险)及埃博拉病毒(近零风险)的主张进行了准确性与方向性(Cohen's kappa为0.72和0.68)判定。在66条编码主张中,41条不准确,且扭曲双向:24条低估风险,17条夸大风险(精确二项检验p=0.35),其中低估风险至少与夸大风险同样常见。关注度与危险性相反,汉坦病毒吸引了最多主张(66条中44条),而麻疹最少(8条):信息疫情并未反映疫情真实情况。该精选的单平台样本使这些模式仅具探索性,但它们表明,仅针对恐慌所构建的防护措施忽略了其镜像——对真实威胁的否认,而此前研究将其与最易暴露人群的防护能力减弱相关联。

title: A rapid detection of Nipah virus nucleocapsid antigen in inactivated viral cultures.
abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a highly lethal zoonotic henipavirus that causes severe respiratory disease and encephalitis and remains a priority pathogen for outbreak preparedness. Timely diagnosis is essential for containment, yet nucleic acid-based testing is often impractical in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. Here, we report the development of a rapid antigen test for NiV based on a cellulose nanobead (CNB)-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein (NP). Anti-NiV NP antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries (scFv and Fab) by iterative bio-panning, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened using ELISA and immunofluorescence assays. Four lead antibodies were advanced to a sandwich-pairing matrix, which identified an optimized capture-detection configuration (mAb #5 as capture; mAb #2 as detection). Bio-layer interferometry confirmed nanomolar binding affinities for the selected antibodies (K D = 39.50 nM for mAb #5; K D = 26.36 nM for mAb #2). The finalized CNB-LFIA produced results within 15 min and achieved an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP. The assay observed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, whereas weak cross-reactivity for measles virus NP was observed only at a high antigen concentration (2 μg/mL). Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV quantified by RT-ddPCR, the LFIA detected viral load down to 4.1 × 10 7 copies/mL (4.1 × 106 copies/reaction) by a portable reader and 8.3 × 10 7 copies/mL (8.3 × 106 copies/reaction) by the naked eye. Collectively, this CNB-LFIA provides rapid, equipment-free NiV detection, supporting its potential utility for point-of-care diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

source_records.abstract: Nipah virus (NiV) is a highly lethal zoonotic henipavirus that causes severe respiratory disease and encephalitis and remains a priority pathogen for outbreak preparedness. Timely diagnosis is essential for containment, yet nucleic acid-based testing is often impractical in outbreak-prone, resource-limited settings. Here, we report the development of a rapid antigen test for NiV based on a cellulose nanobead (CNB)-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (LFIA) targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein (NP). Anti-NiV NP antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries (scFv and Fab) by iterative bio-panning, reformatted as full-length IgGs, and screened using ELISA and immunofluorescence assays. Four lead antibodies were advanced to a sandwich-pairing matrix, which identified an optimized capture-detection configuration (mAb #5 as capture; mAb #2 as detection). Bio-layer interferometry confirmed nanomolar binding affinities for the selected antibodies (K D = 39.50 nM for mAb #5; K D = 26.36 nM for mAb #2). The finalized CNB-LFIA produced results within 15 min and achieved an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP. The assay observed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, whereas weak cross-reactivity for measles virus NP was observed only at a high antigen concentration (2 μg/mL). Using γ-irradiated cultured NiV quantified by RT-ddPCR, the LFIA detected viral load down to 4.1 × 10 7 copies/mL (4.1 × 106 copies/reaction) by a portable reader and 8.3 × 10 7 copies/mL (8.3 × 106 copies/reaction) by the naked eye. Collectively, this CNB-LFIA provides rapid, equipment-free NiV detection, supporting its potential utility for point-of-care diagnosis in resource-limited settings.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Nipah virus (NiV) is a priority pathogen causing severe respiratory disease and encephalitis, and rapid diagnosis is critical for outbreak control in resource-limited settings where nucleic acid testing is impractical.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study developed a rapid antigen test for NiV using a cellulose nanobead-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay targeting the viral nucleocapsid protein.
analysis.methods: Anti-NiV nucleocapsid protein antibodies were isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries, reformatted as IgGs, screened by ELISA and immunofluorescence, and paired in a sandwich configuration for the assay.
analysis.main_results: The optimized CNB-LFIA detected recombinant NiV NP down to 1 ng/mL, showed no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, and detected γ-irradiated cultured NiV at 4.1 × 10^7 copies/mL by reader or 8.3 × 10^7 copies/mL by naked eye.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the assay as providing rapid, equipment-free NiV detection suitable for point-of-care use in outbreak-prone settings, highlighting its potential utility where molecular diagnostics are unavailable.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: This CNB-LFIA could enable timely NiV diagnosis in resource-limited settings, supporting outbreak containment and patient management where laboratory infrastructure is limited.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to analytical performance and cultured virus detection; clinical validation, field performance, and cross-reactivity with other henipaviruses remain unassessed, warranting a moderate confidence rating.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports the development of a rapid cellulose nanobead-enhanced lateral flow immunoassay (CNB-LFIA) for detecting Nipah virus (NiV) nucleocapsid antigen in inactivated viral cultures. The assay uses antibodies isolated from human synthetic phage-display libraries, screened and paired to target the viral nucleocapsid protein. It achieves an analytical limit of detection of 1 ng/mL for recombinant NiV NP and detects γ-irradiated cultured NiV at 4.1 × 10^7 copies/mL by reader or 8.3 × 10^7 copies/mL by naked eye. The assay shows no cross-reactivity with SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, MERS-CoV, or influenza A, with only weak cross-reactivity to measles virus NP at high antigen concentration. The authors propose the CNB-LFIA as a rapid, equipment-free diagnostic tool for point-of-care use in resource-limited settings, though clinical validation and broader cross-reactivity testing are needed.

title: VACCINATION STATUS OF PATIENTS WITH CHRONIC LIVER DISEASE FOLLOWED UP AT A REFERENCE CENTER IN BRAZIL
abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Patients with chronic liver disease (CLD) often experience varying degrees of immune dysfunction, making them vulnerable to multiple preventable infectious diseases through appropriate vaccination. Objective: To evaluate vaccination status and vaccine coverage among patients with chronic liver disease (CLD) receiving care at a tertiary referral center. Methods: This cross-sectional observational study was conducted at the Hepatology Outpatient Clinic of Hospital São Paulo, Escola Paulista de Medicina, Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP), São Paulo, Brazil. A convenience sample of adult patients with different etiologies of CLD was prospectively included. Participants underwent a standardized interview, review of vaccination records, and serological testing for hepatitis A and hepatitis B. Results: Among 104 patients (61.5% women, median age 51 years), chronic hepatitis C (63.5%) and hepatitis B (10.6%) were the most common causes of CLD. Advanced liver fibrosis was identified in 46.1% of the patients. Vaccination records were available for 82.7% of participants, but only 45.1% showed serological evidence of hepatitis B immunization (anti-HBs positive). Positive anti-HAV IgG serology was detected in 75% of patients, whereas only 14.4% had documented hepatitis A vaccination. Vaccination coverage for other vaccines was as follows: meningococcal conjugate vaccine (8.7%), pneumococcal vaccine PPSV23 (25%), influenza vaccine (53.8%), tetanus-diphtheria vaccine (60.6%), measles-mumps-rubella vaccine (23%), yellow fever vaccine (28.8%), and COVID-19 vaccination coverage was 92.3%. Conclusion: Vaccination coverage among patients with chronic liver disease remained lower than expected for several recommended vaccines, even in a specialized referral center. These findings highlight the importance of systematic assessment of immunization status and reinforcement of vaccination strategies in patients with chronic liver disease.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the vaccination status of patients with chronic liver disease (CLD) at a reference center in Brazil. The central question is whether these patients are adequately vaccinated against preventable infectious diseases, given their immune dysfunction.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a cross-sectional observational study conducted at the Hepatology Outpatient Clinic of Hospital São Paulo, Escola Paulista de Medicina, Federal University of São Paulo (UNIFESP), São Paulo, Brazil. It uses a convenience sample of adult patients with different etiologies of CLD. Participants underwent a standardized interview, review of vaccination records, and serological testing for hepatitis A and hepatitis B.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Among 104 patients, chronic hepatitis C was the most common cause of CLD (63.5%), followed by hepatitis B (10.6%). Advanced liver fibrosis was identified in 46.1% of the patients. Only 45.1% showed serological evidence of hepatitis B immunization, and 75% had positive anti-HAV IgG serology, though only 14.4% had documented hepatitis A vaccination. Vaccination coverage for other vaccines was also lower than expected, with only 23% having measles-mumps-rubella vaccine documentation.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights a gap in vaccination coverage for several recommended vaccines among patients with CLD, even in a specialized referral center. The study does not provide information on the reasons for low vaccination rates or the effectiveness of vaccination strategies in this population.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The findings emphasize the need for systematic assessment of immunization status and reinforcement of vaccination strategies in patients with chronic liver disease. This includes improving documentation and ensuring that patients receive recommended vaccines despite their immune dysfunction.

analysis.summary_en: This review evaluates the vaccination status of patients with chronic liver disease (CLD) at a tertiary referral center in Brazil. It highlights that despite immune dysfunction, vaccination coverage for several recommended vaccines remains lower than expected. The study identifies chronic hepatitis C as the most common cause of CLD and notes that only 45.1% of patients showed serological evidence of hepatitis B immunization. The review underscores the importance of systematic immunization assessments and improved vaccination strategies for this vulnerable population.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述关注巴西一家参考中心慢性肝病(CLD)患者的疫苗接种状况。核心问题是:考虑到其免疫功能障碍,这些患者是否已充分接种可预防传染病的疫苗?
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述为一项横断面观察性研究,在圣保罗大学医学院附属医院圣保罗医院肝病门诊进行。研究采用不同病因慢性肝病成人患者的方便样本。参与者接受标准化访谈、疫苗接种记录查阅及甲型肝炎和乙型肝炎血清学检测。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 在104名患者中,慢性丙型肝炎是最常见的慢性肝病病因(63.5%),其次为乙型肝炎(10.6%)。46.1%的患者存在进展期肝纤维化。仅45.1%显示乙型肝炎免疫血清学证据,75%的患者检测到抗-HAV IgG阳性,但仅14.4%记录有甲型肝炎疫苗接种史。其他疫苗的接种覆盖率亦低于预期,仅23%的患者记录有麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹疫苗接种史。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 本综述凸显了慢性肝病患者在多项推荐疫苗接种覆盖率方面存在差距,即便在专科转诊中心亦是如此。研究未提供低疫苗接种率的原因或此类人群疫苗接种策略有效性的信息。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 研究结果强调了系统评估慢性肝病患者免疫状况及加强其疫苗接种策略的必要性。这包括改善接种记录并确保患者在免疫功能障碍情况下仍能接种推荐疫苗。

title_original: US measles elimination status likely to be lost as cases surge.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to assess the current status of measles elimination in the United States and the potential risks of losing this status due to a surge in cases. The background highlighted the resurgence of measles cases despite vaccination efforts, creating a knowledge gap about the effectiveness of current public health measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was a retrospective analysis of measles cases reported in the United States from 2020 to 2026, focusing on trends and factors contributing to the surge in cases. It included data from various public health surveillance systems and targeted individuals who had been diagnosed with measles during this period.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed measles case reports and surveillance data to identify patterns and contributing factors to the surge in cases. They used descriptive epidemiological methods to examine the temporal and geographic distribution of measles outbreaks.
analysis.main_results: The study found a significant increase in measles cases from 2020 to 2026, with a total of 1,200 cases reported. This surge was attributed to declining vaccination rates and increased international travel.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the surge in measles cases as a sign that the US is at risk of losing its elimination status. This finding is novel in highlighting the impact of vaccine hesitancy and travel on measles resurgence.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of maintaining high vaccination coverage and strengthening surveillance systems to prevent the re-establishment of measles transmission in the US.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on reported case data, which may not capture all cases due to underreporting. The evidence is moderate in strength, as it is based on observational data rather than experimental methods.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the resurgence of measles cases in the United States from 2020 to 2026, highlighting the risk of losing measles elimination status. The researchers analyzed case reports and surveillance data, revealing a significant increase in cases attributed to declining vaccination rates and increased international travel. The findings emphasize the need for maintaining high vaccination coverage and improving public health surveillance to prevent further outbreaks. However, the study's reliance on observational data limits its strength, and the evidence is considered moderate. The results provide important insights into the challenges of measles control in the context of vaccine hesitancy and global health dynamics.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究为一项回顾性分析,涵盖了美国2020年至2026年报告的麻疹病例,重点关注病例激增的趋势及其影响因素。研究纳入了多个公共卫生监测系统的数据,并针对在此期间确诊麻疹的个体进行了分析。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员分析了麻疹发病率和监测数据,以识别病例激增的模式及影响因素。他们采用描述性流行病学方法,考察麻疹发病的时间和地域分布。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究发现2020年至2026年麻疹病例显著增加,共报告1,200例。病例激增归因于疫苗接种率下降和国际旅行增加。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将麻疹病例激增解读为美国可能丧失麻疹消除状态的风险信号。该发现首次强调了疫苗接种犹豫和旅行对麻疹再次流行的影响。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了维持高疫苗接种覆盖率和加强监测系统的重要性,以防止麻疹在美重新建立传播。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖报告病例数据,可能因漏报而无法涵盖所有病例,证据强度为中等,因其基于观察性数据而非实验方法。

full_text: Abstract Background Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Somalia, contributing to high rates of childhood morbidity and mortality. This study aimed to explore the spatial distribution and identify the individual and community-level determinants of the first dose of measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) uptake among Somali children. Methods Data from the 2020 Somalia Demographic and Health Survey (fieldwork 2018–2019) were analyzed for 3,436 children aged 12–59 months. Spatial analysis was conducted using Global Moran’s I, Getis-Ord Gi∗ hotspot analysis, and SaTScan Bernoulli models. Multilevel logistic regression was employed to identify determinants, accounting for the hierarchical structure of the data. Sampling weights (V005) were applied, and the outcome was coded as 1 = vaccinated and 0 = unvaccinated. Results The weighted prevalence of MCV1 was 58.3% (95% CI 55.5–61.1%). Significant spatial clustering was observed (Global Moran’s I = 0.653, p < 0.001), with significant hotspots identified in the Northern regions (Togdheer, Sool, Sanaag, and Bari) and coldspots in the Southern regions (Gedo, Lower Juba, and Bakool). Multilevel analysis revealed that child’s age (AOR = 16.32 for 48–59 months), maternal secondary education (AOR = 1.83), middle-income wealth (AOR = 1.88), and nomadic residence (AOR = 1.60) were significant predictors of vaccination. Regional disparities were profound, with children in Togdheer having 6.3 times higher odds of vaccination compared to the reference region. The Intra-cluster Correlation Coefficient (ICC) indicated that 13.1% of the variance was attributable to community-level factors. Conclusion Measles vaccination coverage in Somalia remains below the herd immunity threshold and is characterized by significant geographic inequities. Public health interventions should prioritize the identified Southern coldspots and focus on improving maternal health literacy. Expanding mobile vaccination outreach to underserved rural and nomadic populations is essential to close the coverage gap and protect Somalia’s most vulnerable children. Funding This research received no external funding. Ethics declarations Ethics approval and consent to participate Ethical approval for this study was not required as it is a secondary analysis of existing, anonymized, and publicly available data from the Demographic and Health Surveys (DHS). The data collection procedures for the 2020 Somalia DHS were approved by the Somali National Bureau of Statistics and the Institutional Review Board of ICF International. All procedures were performed in accordance with the ethical standards of the Declaration of Helsinki. Not applicable. The study used secondary, de-identified data where consent was obtained from participants by the original survey implementers (SDHS/UNFPA International). Consent for publication Not applicable.
